apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Leaving the app no longer pauses your session. After the iOS update, iOS reports a fake 'interruption' when it backgrounds the app; real ones (a call, Siri, an alarm) still pause.

Chris's updated program: scar massage, ankle pumps, active inversion/eversion, foot doming, plantarflexion isometric into the wall ball, band eversion + inversion superset (3 rounds), seated calf raise with manual resistance, then toe yoga (15 each move). Trunk rotation, hip rotation and the in-boot isometrics are out.
Hamstring stretch now happens during the cuff-off break of your BFR round (left then right, ~40 s each) instead of as its own exercise.
